name: Filter & Sort
description: Filter arrays by conditions, find items, remove duplicates, and sort by fields with custom logic.

properties.name: filterConditions
properties.description: Define conditions to filter items. All conditions must match (AND logic).

fields.name: field
fields.description: Field path to filter by (supports nested paths like 'user.name')

fields.name: value
fields.description: Value to compare against. Can use {{data.field}}

properties.name: sortFields
properties.description: Define fields to sort by. First field has priority, then second, etc.

fields.name: field
fields.description: Field to sort by (supports nested paths)

properties.name: uniqueField
properties.placeholder: id, email (leave empty for full object comparison)

properties.name: limitCount
properties.description: Maximum number of items to return
